clue.text: Guard at church coming between wife and husband?

indicators.note: the pieces for at and church arrive in the middle, separating wife from husband

parts.note: a husband is a man

explanation.surface: A sentry posted at church who steps in between a quarrelling married couple.
explanation.definitionFit: A watchman is a person employed to keep guard over a building, especially at night.

clue.text: Device I would obtain to prop up top of window

indicators.note: in a down answer the later pieces sit below, supporting what is on top
the top letter in a down clue is the first letter of window

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I would
to get is to obtain

explanation.surface: A gadget used to hold a window open.
explanation.definitionFit: A widget is a small gadget or mechanical contrivance.

clue.text: Evidence in court set up — Athenian guilty finally

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written
Timon of Athens is the title figure of Shakespeare's play

indicators.note: takes the final letter of guilty

explanation.surface: Courtroom evidence was framed, but the Athenian was guilty in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Testimony is a formal statement given by a witness under oath.

clue.text: Time of festival — Rev's looking silly in tricorn maybe

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step

parts.note: a tricorn is a three-cornered hat, one example of a hat

indicators.note: the clergyman's letters are made to look ridiculous, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vicar looks absurd wearing a three-cornered hat at the village festival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' sets the jumbled ARVES inside HAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Harvest is the season of gathering crops, celebrated with a harvest festival.

clue.text: Place of many races where you'll see a northerner

parts.note: a Scot comes from the north of Britain

explanation.surface: A cosmopolitan spot where among many ethnicities you'll meet someone from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascot is a famous English racecourse; 'races' suggests ethnic groups but means horse races.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascot is a racecourse in Berkshire hosting many horse races each year.

clue.text: Formula for getting bed assembled

indicators.note: a formula is a recipe, so the clue asks what instruction would yield the word bed

parts.note: the word splits into its first letter and its last two, which a joining word can link

explanation.surface: Instructions for putting together a flat-pack bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as three words, B AND ED: that is the formula which gives BED.
explanation.definitionFit: Banded together means joined up as a group, so banded can mean gathered or united.

clue.text: Bitter writer sitting beneath tree

indicators.note: in a down answer the writer's letters come below the tree's

parts.note: Acer is the maple genus
a Bic is a brand of ballpoint pen

explanation.surface: A sour author sitting under a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Acerbic means sharp and harsh in tone, as cutting speech is.

clue.text: On account of two playing together love ensues

indicators.note: the love letter follows the duet, so it comes after it

parts.note: a duet is a piece played by two performers
love is zero, O, in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: Two musicians performing together fall in love as a result.
explanation.definitionFit: Due to means because of, caused by.

clue.text: Daughter is getting behind — almost a total failure?

indicators.note: the word for behind loses its last letter

parts.note: astern means behind, at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A daughter falling behind in school, almost a complete washout.
explanation.definitionFit: A disaster is a complete fiasco, something that goes utterly wrong.

clue.text: Being most scatty, gets confused about identity one way and another

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the identity letters
the letters of gets are muddled into a new order

parts.note: ID is identity; written forwards and then backwards it gives ID and DI

explanation.surface: The scattiest person gets mixed up over who they are.
explanation.definitionFit: Giddiest means the most dizzy or flighty, so the most scatterbrained.

clue.text: Quality of one smashing seductress I've not lovelessly abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: love is O, the zero score in tennis, so 'not' loses its O

explanation.surface: Describing the allure of a heartbreaking temptress who has abandoned her lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lovelessly' strips the O from NOT, leaving NT; SEDUCTRESS, IVE and NT are then rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Destructiveness is the property of something that wrecks or smashes things.

clue.text: Outstanding hospital department with parts separated by tunnel

indicators.note: the department's letters are split apart and the tunnel goes into the gap

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
a mine is an underground tunnel

explanation.surface: A hospital department split into wings by an underground passage.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent means distinguished, standing out above others in a field.

clue.text: Label certain notes "of uncertain authenticity"

parts.note: to dub is to name or label
IOUs are notes promising repayment of debt

explanation.surface: Marking some banknotes as possible forgeries.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dubious is questionable, of doubtful genuineness.

clue.text: Pair carrying old item of furniture easy to get to the skip?

definitions.text: easy to get to the skip?

indicators.note: the pair's letters hold the old letter between them

parts.note: a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Two people lugging an old table out to a rubbish skip.
explanation.walkthrough: A skip is a large open bin for rubbish; anything light enough to carry to one is portable.
explanation.definitionFit: Portable means light enough to be carried about easily, here to a waste container.

clue.text: Pain of second celebrity landing outside hospital

parts.note: to second a proposal is to back it

indicators.note: the celebrity's letters land around the hospital letter

parts.note: an ace is a star performer

explanation.surface: A celebrity's painful second landing outside a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Backache is an ache in the back, a common pain.

clue.text: Manage to catch last of criminals in wood

indicators.note: the word for manage holds the extra letter inside it

parts.note: to cope is to manage

indicators.note: takes the final letter of criminals

explanation.surface: Coping with the job of rounding up the last criminals hiding among the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A copse is a small group of trees, a little wood.

clue.text: Phony prince initially about to get offer

indicators.note: takes the first letter of prince

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to tender is to offer

explanation.surface: A bogus prince is about to receive a bid.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretender is someone who falsely claims a title, a fake or impostor.

clue.text: Pastoral deity — dull-looking or a dish?

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of shepherds and the countryside
dowdy means drab and unfashionable

explanation.surface: Is the god of the countryside drab, or is he attractive?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dish' teases as slang for an attractive person; it is food.
explanation.definitionFit: Pandowdy is an American baked dessert of spiced apples under a crust.

clue.text: A very good person protecting you up to now

indicators.note: the saint's letters wrap round, shielding the word for you

parts.note: ST, a saint, is a very good person
ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: A saintly figure has been shielding you so far.
explanation.definitionFit: As yet means so far, until the present time.

clue.text: Foot in fixed position before toe is manipulated

indicators.note: before puts the fixed-position word ahead of the reworked letters

parts.note: a door pushed to is closed, in a fixed position

indicators.note: the letters of toe is are worked by hand into another order

explanation.surface: A podiatrist manipulating a toe while the foot is held still.
explanation.definitionFit: Tootsie is a playful word for a foot or toe.

clue.text: Scot had to appear nasty about English and Poles

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the English letter
nasty signals the letters of Scot had being turned into an ugly mess

explanation.surface: A Scot had to come across as unpleasant to the English and the Poles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' looks like the nationality; it means electrical poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Cathodes are negative electrodes, the poles of a cell or valve.

clue.text: Away from home a long time when torches may be necessary?

parts.note: out means not at home
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: Being away from home for a long time, when torches might be needed.
explanation.walkthrough: A torch is the British word for a flashlight, needed in a power cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Outages are power cuts, times when the electricity fails and lights go out.

clue.text: Roundabout way Times gets free access?

parts.note: by means times in multiplication, as in three by four
a pass gives free entry

explanation.surface: The Times newspaper gets complimentary entry by a detour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper, but it is the multiplication word.
explanation.definitionFit: A bypass is a road that goes round a town, an indirect route.

clue.text: Go down and see graduate getting certificate

parts.note: to dip is to go down
lo is an old word for look or see
an MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate

explanation.surface: Taking a dip in fortunes, then seeing a graduate receive her certificate.
explanation.definitionFit: A diploma is a certificate awarded for completing a course of study.

clue.text: Something to eat when one of the minions entertains king?

indicators.note: to entertain is to host, so the pawn holds the king inside

parts.note: a pawn is a lowly underling used by others
R is the abbreviation for king, Latin rex

explanation.surface: When an underling hosts the king, something must be served to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A prawn is a small shellfish eaten as food.

clue.text: Young magician with the ultimate in spooky craft

parts.note: Harry Potter is the boy wizard of the books

indicators.note: the ultimate letter is the last one of spooky

explanation.surface: A boy wizard displays his skill in the spooky arts.
explanation.definitionFit: Pottery is the craft of making pots and ceramics.

clue.text: Some chap, a bloke making a name in Spain

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A man making a name for himself in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Pablo is a common Spanish male forename, as in Picasso.

clue.text: Sigh with a debate rambling: an expression of annoyance

indicators.note: a rambling debate wanders all over, so its letters are scattered

explanation.surface: Someone sighing through a long, meandering argument and finally losing patience.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an irritated demand to know why someone has done something.

clue.text: Bet there will be no turning back — eager not to stop

indicators.note: the word for no is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: nay means no

indicators.note: the word for eager is not allowed to finish, losing its final letter

parts.note: keen means eager

explanation.surface: A gambler vowing never to back down from an eager wager.
explanation.walkthrough: A Yankee is a British bookmaker's term for a combined bet: eleven bets on four selections.
explanation.definitionFit: A Yankee is a multiple wager covering several horses in doubles, trebles and an accumulator.

clue.text: Partners, kind to get involved in tricks

indicators.note: the word for kind is drawn inside the word for tricks

parts.note: cons are swindles or tricks
a sort is a kind

explanation.surface: Business partners of a certain kind getting mixed up in scams.
explanation.definitionFit: Consorts are companions or spouses, especially of a monarch.
